dapp.giftTitle: Join Fly Infinity Gift Smart Contract & Participate in $5 Prize Lottery
dapp.agreementP1: By entering the Fly Infinity ecosystem, participants acknowledge their role as strategic investors within a decentralized financial framework. Acquisition of the native digital asset, FIT, is contingent upon the prior purchase of a Fly Infinity ownership share. Upon obtaining this share, participants are granted the right to acquire FIT tokens in varying amounts, ranging from $1 to $100 per transaction, either incrementally or in a single transaction, based on their discretion and investment strategy.
dapp.agreementP2: The capital contributed toward the acquisition of an ownership share constitutes a non-recoverable commitment. This contribution is not subject to withdrawal or refund under any circumstances. However, this share confers perpetual membership within the network, requiring no further renewal, top-up, or recurring fees throughout the participant's engagement with the ecosystem.
dapp.agreementP3: In contrast to the ownership share, any FIT tokens acquired through the platform remain entirely liquid and redeemable at the participant's discretion. There are no restrictions on withdrawal, and participants may convert their FIT holdings to value at any time, without delay or penalty.
dapp.agreementP4: Each ownership share entitles the participant to a predetermined allocation of lottery-based rewards. Specifically, participants may win up to twenty (20) individual gifts, each valued at $5, through the platform's transparent and automated reward distribution mechanism.
dapp.agreementP5: Upon successful registration and activation of an ownership share, a welcome bonus equivalent to $2 in FIT tokens is instantly and automatically credited to the participant's wallet. This bonus serves as an introductory benefit and is processed at the exact moment of network entry.
dapp.agreementP6: Each ownership share generates a unique and immutable referral identifier. This identifier is intrinsically linked to the participant's BNB wallet address, which functions as their official referral code. Through active community expansion and network development, participants are empowered to progressively unlock elevated purchase caps, enabling the acquisition of larger volumes of FIT tokens in subsequent transactions.
dapp.agreementP7: In recognition of network growth and community development, the ecosystem allocates monetary rewards in USD to qualifying participants. These rewards are processed and settled on an hourly basis, ensuring timely and transparent compensation for those contributing to the expansion of the Fly Infinity network.
dapp.agreementP8: Fly Infinity is built on decentralized blockchain infrastructure. Ownership registration and FIT token operations are executed through smart contracts on BNB Smart Chain. Participants connect using their own wallets and authorize blockchain operations directly. Public on-chain records provide transparent, independently verifiable activity, while wallet addresses enable pseudonymous participation. This architecture brings together transparency, user-directed authorization and verifiable blockchain execution.

dapp.agreementHeadingGames: Fly Infinity Games — Complimentary Game Access
dapp.agreementGames: An activated Fly Infinity Ownership Share unlocks complimentary access to the Fly Infinity Games Hub for the registered wallet. Owners can enjoy the current collection—Chess Arena, Backgammon, Hokm, Ludo, and Snakes & Ladders—across its available play modes. Wallet activation uses a free message signature and a minimum balance of 1 FIT. The collection brings together accessible, social entertainment as part of the Fly Infinity ecosystem.
dapp.agreementHeadingAi: Fly AI — Complimentary Access to the Intelligence Suite
dapp.agreementAi: An activated Ownership Share unlocks the Fly AI workspace for the registered wallet. The current suite features eight specialist assistants: General Fly AI, Legal Consultant, English Language Coach, Parenting Consultant, Health & Beauty Advisor, Book Advisor, Culture Guide, and Network & Leadership Coach. It also brings together FIT Intelligence, transaction analysis, contract intelligence, read-only blockchain tools, Fly Infinity Image Studio for AI image generation, and Fly Infinity Audio Studio with Voice-over, Music Maker and Sound Effects. Wallet ownership verification activates access, and daily usage capacity is organized by ownership tier and the allowances displayed in the workspace. The suite continues to evolve as new capabilities are introduced.
dapp.agreementHeadingFuture: Future Fly Infinity Products — Owner Benefits
dapp.agreementFuture: Activated Ownership Share holders receive complimentary access to future Fly Infinity products and services as each release is introduced as an owner benefit. Official launch announcements present the included capabilities and activation details for each new experience. The ownership program grows alongside the Fly Infinity ecosystem, bringing members into new digital experiences as they become available.
dapp.agreementScope: These benefits are access privileges linked to activated Ownership Share status. Unless a separate binding written instrument expressly states otherwise, purchasing an Ownership Share does not by itself grant direct equity, legal title to assets, governance rights in, or entitlement to revenue or profits from any individual game, AI service, affiliated entity, third-party provider or future project. Any such separate rights must be expressly documented. Product-specific terms and applicable laws continue to apply.
